Definition: middle voice from G1909 and G373; to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely):--rest in (upon).
BiblicalUsage: To settle on, to rest upon. If the son of peace is there, your peace shall rest upon it, in Luke 10:6 — and Paul says the Jew rests in the law and makes his boast of God in Romans 2:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe peace rests where it is welcome and returns where it is not, and the only safe resting place is not the law but the Lord who gave it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
